en.headline: Legco resumes second reading of Northern Metropolis Development Bill on Wednesday
en.dek: The bills committee finished scrutiny after 12 meetings and about 30 hours, and the bill could complete passage this week if supported.
body: The Legislative Council will resume the second reading debate on the Northern Metropolis Development Bill on Wednesday, the Legco Secretariat said.

Bills committee chair Priscilla Leung said the panel held 12 meetings and spent about 30 hours examining the bill and five pieces of subsidiary legislation. She called it the first dedicated law for a single area in Hong Kong’s history.

The bill aims to streamline planning and land administration procedures so development of the Northern Metropolis can proceed more quickly. It does not include tax concessions or other investment incentives.
If members support the second reading, the bill will go to the committee of the whole Council. After that stage, it can be set down for third reading the same day.

The government has said it will submit the first batch of subsidiary legislation covering town planning, land compensation, building works, noise control and cross-boundary flows once the main bill is passed.

zh.headline: 立法會周三恢復二讀《北部都會區發展條例草案》
zh.dek: 法案委員會完成約30小時審議，若獲支持，本周內可完成三讀程序。
body: 立法會秘書處表示，立法會將於星期三恢復《北部都會區發展條例草案》的二讀辯論。
法案委員會主席梁美芬表示，委員會舉行了12次會議，花約30小時逐條審議草案及五條附屬法例。她形容這是香港歷史上首條針對單一地區的專屬法例。
草案旨在精簡城市規劃及土地行政程序，加快北部都會區發展。內容集中於拆牆鬆綁，並不包括稅務優惠或其他投資誘因。
若議員支持二讀，草案將交付全體委員會審議。全體委員會完成工作後，可同日進行三讀。
政府表示，主體法例通過後，將提交首批附屬法例，涵蓋城市規劃、收地補償、建築工程審批、噪音管制及跨境流動等範疇。
